newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent falls on profit taking, weak NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent falls on profit taking, weak NYMEX.

text.p: Brent crude futures were traded lower in Asia on Friday as players started to square positions ahead of next week.

February Brent was traded 25 cents lower to $23.73 per barrel on Friday towards the SIMEX close. London rose six cents overnight to $23.98 pushed higher by a firm NYMEX expiry of the January contract.
But brokers said the North American cold weather remained the major supporting factor for the market.
"I think people are squaring up," said one broker. "But if the weather is anything to go by it could be in a for a cold spell in the next 10 days or so. Weather seems to be the issue."
NYMEX crude also fell, with February last traded at $25.21 on ACCESS, down 24 cents compared with a $25.45 close in New York.
NYMEX January heating oil was sharply lower, shedding 0.73 cent to 73.05 cents per gallon on ACCESS, while gasoline lost 0.42 cent to 70.80.
Crude markets are expected to be thinly traded next week during the Christmas holiday period.
